_candidate_name: L1-clean product-side hard gate and budget overlay
_candidate_note: Current preferred S1 mainline candidate. It keeps the current mainline contract rules, B6 ranking, IV/VRP gates, redline, holiday block, and post-trigger VWAP stop, but adds a Ledet-style L1 product-side gate: historical_retention_score_bucket5_date >= 4 and tail_cluster_safety_score_bucket5_date >= 3. In the 2022-01-04 to 2026-03-31 run, it produced lower drawdown and fewer stop losses than the PSO candidate, with lower deployment.
